snippet.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The free demo of Graveyard Keeper 2 is available now for both PC (Steam) and consoles! 

Pre-order Graveyard Keeper 2 now: https://www.graveyardkeeper2.com/

Graveyard Keeper 2 launches 22 September 2026 on PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch. 

Pre-order the sequel to your favourite unhinged classic now to get exclusive bonuses, such as a Sauna building to lift your spirits after a long and productive day and an outfit fit worthy of the new Grand Inquisitor (that’s you!).
